# aikidoe

> Design of experiments in the browser and on the command line: screening, factorials, response surfaces, split-plot and wafer/site process experiments, gauge R&R, robust design and simulator yield. Everything runs locally; a study is one JSON file. MIT licence.

An agent helping a user plan or analyse an experiment should load the skill first: it says when to use aikidoe, the workflow (elicit → define → recommend → design → run sheet → import → analyse → next stage → report), what to ask the user, how to choose a design, the rules (never invent results, keep randomisation, check estimability and power, state aliasing, give intervals, hand cost and safety decisions back to the user) and tested command recipes. Every `doe` command takes `--json`.

## Optional

- [MCP server](https://github.com/byzantic/aikidoe/blob/main/tools/mcp.mjs): the same commands as MCP tools over stdio, for agents without a shell
- [Exercises and virtual processes](docs/manual/exercises.md): practice and evaluation with a hidden truth
- [Covariates](docs/manual/analysis.md) (section "Covariates"): variables measured at each run but not set (a starting weight, room temperature, cell passage number) as model terms — `doe covariate`, a column on the run sheet, `fit "y ~ … + id"`; effects and predictions at the covariate's mean; `doe means` for adjusted means, Tukey comparisons and the equal-slopes test; `doe allocate` balances a covariate known in advance (units to runs); `doe power --rho`; `doe optimise --fix "id=value"`
- [Where the runs are](docs/manual/concepts.md) (section "Where the runs are"): pairs plots of the runs, the scaled prediction variance over two factors, the variance dispersion graph; `doe plot`
- [Screening designs](docs/manual/designs-screening.md): Plackett–Burman (generalised resolution) and definitive screening; projectivity — what the same runs can still fit once a few factors turn out active
- [Mixture designs](docs/manual/designs-mixture.md): components adding up to a total — lattice, centroid, extreme vertices, optimal; Scheffé models, Cox traces
- [Dose–response](docs/manual/dose-response.md): EC50, relative potency, parallelism, standard curves, dose designs
- [Microplates](docs/manual/plates.md): runs in the wells of 96/384/1536-well plates — layouts, controls, Z′, position terms
- [Source](https://github.com/byzantic/aikidoe)
